certification.name: Certified Penetration Testing Engineer
certification.description: Penetration testing certification assessed by a 100-question online exam with no course prerequisite. Sold as an unproctored standard exam or as a live-proctored ANAB-accredited version (C)PTE-A, two hours, 62% to pass, renewed every three years).
certification.currency_note: Exam Combo regular price (prep guide, practice quiz, two attempts); on sale at $200 on 2026-11-10, the proctored ANSI / DoD 8140 version at $240
